opening.argument: The speaker presents OneCoin as an investment opportunity tied to profitability for coin holders, then promotes a split program that can double a participant's tokens. The offer adds team-building rewards, framing recruitment and helping others participate as ways to earn. The call to "Use this chance and register right now" is reinforced by a claim that available positions are limited, alongside a registration-form graphic and an invitation to join One Network. These combined promises create pressure to act on projected token growth and rewards, although the available evidence does not establish that the projected returns were realized.
